verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5090 is a consumer GPU. It has no production data or hosted service, so a sandbox-versus-production test environment is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships a sandbox capability. CUDA containers on NGC are a developer building block, not a sandbox isolated from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
